name: Oil Pump, Pan & Pickup
description: Wet-sump oil pump, pickup, windage/baffling, ZL1 oil pan, filter adapter and dipstick/fill; dry-sump pan alternatives (the dry-sump pump/tank/lines live in engine-support).

components.name: Engine oil pump (wet sump, crank-driven variable displacement)
components.description: Gen V wet-sump engines use a crank-driven, variable-displacement vane pump mounted to the front of the block behind the front cover, with pressure commanded by the ECM. A dry-sump conversion replaces it with an external belt-driven pump (see engine-support).
components.location: Front of block around the crank snout, inside the front cover.

factory.name: GM LT1/LT4 wet-sump oil pump (2014-2021)
factory.notes: GM 12744612 listed for 2022-2024 Camaro LT1/LT4. Vendor note: GM variable-vane pumps are prone to failure if removed and reinstalled after use - replace rather than reuse. Will not fit dry-sump engines.

raceOptions.name: Katech Gen V LT1/LT4/LT5 wet sump oil pump (billet 4140 gear)
raceOptions.notes: Direct replacement, no tuning required per Katech. Doweled-pump Blackwing/Escalade-V need KAT-A7734.

hardware.notes: Summit and Michigan Motorsports both list 18 ft-lb.

installNotes: Prime the pump with oil; align the drive to the crank flats; center the pump per GM procedure before torquing.
Prime the whole engine with a pressure primer through a galley port before first start.
inspection: Log oil pressure vs rpm and oil temp every session; pressure drop in long corners = pickup starvation.

modelRef.features: Crank-driven variable-displacement vane pump on the snout, 4 bolts, pickup port at the bottom

components.name: Oil pickup tube & screen (with inlet O-ring)
components.description: Tube and screen that draws oil from the pan sump to the pump inlet; sealed at the pump by an O-ring. For road racing, its position relative to the pan baffles/trap door is critical.
components.location: Inside the oil pan, from the sump bowl forward to the pump inlet.

raceOptions.name: Pan-matched pickup supplied with aftermarket baffled pans
raceOptions.notes: Use the pickup designed for the pan.

installNotes: Check pickup-to-pan floor clearance (commonly ~0.25-0.375 in, estimate) with clay.
Lube O-ring; seat fully before bolting.

sources.title: Michigan Motorsports: LS / LT Engine Torque Specs (2014+ Gen V LT section)
Michigan Motorsports: GM 12666993 oil pump inlet seal, Gen V LT

modelRef.features: Steel tube with 2-bolt flange at the pump and flat screen in the rear sump

components.name: Windage tray / pan baffle
components.description: Tray between the crank and the oil surface that strips oil off the rotating assembly and keeps sump oil from being whipped up. Race pans add trap-door baffles around the pickup to stop starvation under lateral g.
components.location: Bolted under the main caps / inside the pan.

factory.name: GM Gen V pan baffle/windage arrangement (integrated with pan)

raceOptions.name: Baffled road-race pan with trap doors / crank scraper

installNotes: Check scraper clearance to rods and counterweights (0.060 in min, typical).

modelRef.features: Louvred steel tray under the crank

components.name: Oil pan (wet sump, ZL1)
components.description: Structural cast-aluminum two-piece pan (upper and lower) carrying the sump, filter mount and oil level sensor. Camaro ZL1/1LE wet sumps are well baffled, but hard-tire road racing at sustained >1.2 g usually justifies a dry sump.
components.location: Bottom of the engine, below the crank; bolts to block, front cover and rear cover; sits above the front cradle.

factory.name: GM Camaro ZL1 LT4 wet-sump oil pan
factory.notes: LT4 wet sump capacity 10.0 qt (Summit). Summit lists LT1 wet sump at 6.5 qt - verify Camaro SS capacity against owner’s manual.

raceOptions.name: Holley LT1 & LT4 Gen V swap oil pan
raceOptions.notes: Swap pan - verify Camaro cradle/steering rack clearance.

raceOptions.name: Fluidworks Gen V LT 5-stage billet dry sump pan/pump kit
raceOptions.notes: Integral pump eliminates external scavenge lines; racing use only.

raceOptions.name: Fluidworks Gen V LT 6-stage billet dry sump pan/pump kit
raceOptions.notes: Fits factory Gen V and Noonan LT blocks, clears up to 4.125 in stroke.

hardware.torqueSequence: Snug all, then center-out to final.

hardware.item: Oil pan to front cover bolt
Oil pan to rear cover bolt
Lower pan to upper pan bolt

hardware.notes: Safety-wire or use a drilled plug for racing (rule requirement in many series).

fluids.name: Engine oil
fluids.spec: Street: dexos-approved grade per owner’s manual (verify for your model year); race: 10W-40/15W-50 full synthetic per builder (Mobil 1 / Driven / Motul)

installNotes: Place RTV at the 4 T-joints where front/rear cover meet the block; new pan gasket.
Align pan flush to rear of block (bellhousing face) with a straightedge before torquing so the trans seats flat.
Torque pan-to-block, then front and rear cover bolts.
inspection: Check for cracks/impacts on the pan bottom after off-track excursions; check drain plug safety wire.

components.name: Oil filter, filter mount & oil-cooler adapter
components.description: Spin-on full-flow oil filter on the oil pan with the factory oil-cooler adapter/thermostat. Race cars often delete the factory cooler loop with a block-off plate and run a remote filter/cooler (engine-support).

factory.name: GM Gen V oil filter adapter & ACDelco oil filter

raceOptions.name: ICT Billet Gen 5 LT oil cooler bypass / delete block-off plate

installNotes: Pre-fill the filter, oil the gasket, hand tighten plus 3/4 turn (filter maker spec).
inspection: Cut open filter after every event.

components.name: Oil dipstick, tube & oil filler tube
components.description: Dipstick tube and oil filler tube with cap. The Gen V uses a separate filler tube (GM 12668614) on top of the engine. Race cars secure the dipstick with a clip/safety wire.
components.location: Filler tube at top-front of the engine; dipstick tube along the side of the block.

hardware.notes: Checked 2026-10: GM SI fastener table for the C7 LT1 (screenshots reposted on CorvetteForum) lists 'Oil Level Indicator Tube Bolt 10 N·m (88 lb in)'. The 2016-18 Camaro SM (via TightTorque) lists the oil level indicator tube bracket bolt at 10 N·m.

installNotes: Replace tube O-rings; secure the dipstick so it cannot pop out under crankcase pressure.
